DocumentUpload.description:
An accepted upload: the document, and the parse_document task reading it while it is processing.
Poll GET /api/tasks/{task_id}, then GET the document. task_id is null when there is nothing left to
wait for: a duplicate of a file already read.
DocumentUpload.title: DocumentUpload

LinkUpload.description:
An added or refreshed link, and the fetch_link task fetching it while it is processing. task_id is
null when nothing is fetched: LinkedIn and X links are only saved.
LinkUpload.title: LinkUpload
